title: Spiral Matrix (JavaScript, harder)
prompt:
In this project directory, implement a Node.js CommonJS module named spiral_matrix.js exporting one function via module.exports = { spiral }:
  - spiral(n) : returns an n x n matrix (as an array of n arrays, each of length n) filled with the integers 1..n*n in clockwise spiral order, starting at the top-left corner and spiraling inward. n=0 returns an empty array []. Throw an Error for n < 0.
There is already a hidden reference test suite at tests/test_spiral_matrix.test.js (uses Node's built-in node:test + node:assert, no npm install needed) -- do NOT modify it. Your Testing phase should run `node --test tests/*.test.js` from the project root (in addition to any tests you write yourself) and every test must pass. Also add a short README.md explaining the spiral rule with a small example.
